mapper.select: SELECT t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.first_miss AS firstMiss, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GOAL_ACTIVITY a2 JOIN GOAL g2 ON a2.GOAL_NO = g2.NO WHERE g2.OWNER_ID = t.owner_id AND a2.STATUS IN ('DONE', 'SHORT_DONE') AND DATE(a2.DONE_AT) > t.first_miss AND DATE(a2.DONE_AT) <= DATE_ADD(t.first_miss, INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) AS recovered FROM ( SELECT g.OWNER_ID AS owner_id, MIN( CASE WHEN a.MISSED_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN a.MISSED_DATE WHEN a.STATUS = 'PLANNED' AND g.STATUS <> 'PAUSED' AND a.ACT_DATE < #{today} THEN a.ACT_DATE END ) AS first_miss FROM GOAL_ACTIVITY a JOIN GOAL g ON a.GOAL_NO = g.NO GROUP BY g.OWNER_ID ) t WHERE t.first_miss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.owner_id

SELECT g.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, a.STATUS AS status, a.ACT_DATE AS actDate FROM GOAL g JOIN GOAL_ACTIVITY a ON a.GOAL_NO = g.NO WHERE g.NO = (SELECT MIN(g2.NO) FROM GOAL g2 WHERE g2.OWNER_ID = g.OWNER_ID) AND a.NO = ( SELECT a2.NO FROM GOAL_ACTIVITY a2 WHERE a2.GOAL_NO = g.NO ORDER BY a2.ACT_DATE, a2.START_TIME, a2.NO LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY g.OWNER_ID
SELECT g.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, MAX(g.STATUS = 'DONE') AS completed, MAX(g.STATUS = 'DONE' OR g.END_DATE < #{today}) AS ended FROM GOAL g GROUP BY g.OWNER_ID ORDER BY g.OWNER_ID
SELECT a.STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM GOAL_ACTIVITY a GROUP BY a.STATUS
